concepts.definition: A Project Reference-Frame Basis is a Product-owned accepted declaration of the shared frame set for finite actors engaging one governed Product scope or outcome. It binds the exact Reference Frame Method and optional profile, admitting authorities and scopes, frame declarations and evaluation inventory, actor rules and capabilities, semantic/evaluation/operation/decision grants, result/conjunction/translation/coverage relations, activation triggers and invalidation law.

grounding.quote: + lifecycle activation triggers and invalidation law

concepts.label: Project Reference-Frame Basis

concepts.definition: Agent Frame Activation is an execution-scoped binding of one agent to an applicable frame declaration or active configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis, evidence boundary and capability envelope. The durable Product Definition Overlay records the shared basis; a ticket or other authorized instruction carries the activation packet. Frames and actors are separate identities.

grounding.quote:
is the execution-scoped binding of one agent to an applicable
frame declaration or active configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis,
evidence boundary, and capability envelope.

concepts.label: Agent Frame Activation

concepts.definition: Build tenancy, owned here in urn:stdo:bounded-context:build-tenancy under a selected complete STDO basis, is the one-or-more realization relation from a common constitutional WHAT to independent project-owned HOW tenants. A build tenant is one realization; multi-build-tenancy means more than one. WHAT supplies requirements; tenant design supplies computational operations, composition, performers, effects, assumptions and observation bindings. The Tenant Registry is how.build_tenants; how.common binds an explicitly shared realization law.

grounding.quote:
A
**build tenant** is one such realization. **Build tenancy** is the one-or-more
relation; one tenant is its singleton case and multi-build-tenancy begins when
the same `WHAT` has more than one independent realization.

concepts.label: WHAT, HOW and build tenancy

concepts.definition: The discovered definition set consists of stdo_*.json definitions recursively located inside a selected workspace, including its root and arbitrarily deep project roots. Explicit directed composition relates otherwise independent definitions using a target locator, expected stable definition identity, relation authority and non-empty governing contract references.

grounding.quote:
Tools discover `stdo_*.json` recursively within the selected workspace
boundary. Discovery includes definitions at the workspace root and definitions
at arbitrarily deep nested project roots.

concepts.label: Recursive discovery and explicit composition

concepts.definition: Semantic-resolution conformance concerns uniquely resolved uses and material collisions under an exact selected basis. A local positive case declares one context and exactly one concept; a cross-context positive case supplies a complete authorized relation. Frame, Owner, Product, Tenant and User are explicit collision cases with distinct context-dependent meanings.

grounding.quote:
A positive local case declares one context and resolves exactly one concept. A
positive cross-context case supplies the complete authorized relation.

concepts.label: Semantic-resolution conformance

concepts.definition: STDO-SURFACE-001 describes a modularly authored but singularly authoritative constitution: one complete released method cut, one owning standard per law, and reference consumption by other standards. A released cut identifies its exact members, digests, review basis, human acceptance and immutable identity. Derived, evidential and authoring surfaces include compressions, templates, comments, candidate work, installed copies and mutable source.

grounding.quote:
The shared methodology is modular in authorship and singular in authority.
Each law has one owning standard; other standards consume it by reference. The
standards become operative only as one complete released STDO version.

concepts.label: Released method constitution

concepts.definition: The constitutional chain runs Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta → Scenarios → Gap Analysis → intake-selected re-entry or observation. Goals own current concerns; Intent purpose/direction; mutable Product Definition current realization, terms and end-state shape; Requirements invariant obligations; Design structural decisions, interfaces, carriers and topology; Realisation their concrete enactment; Observations bounded facts; Projection question-relevant views; Delta drift; Scenarios operational meaning; Gap Analysis insufficiency. ADRs are durable Design records, not an additional constitutional layer. GOALS.md carries a bounded work wave; PRODUCT.md bridges direction to decomposable obligations and is neither immutable release artifact nor installed product.

grounding.quote:
Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                  Scenarios
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                Gap Analysis
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                  Intake-selected re-entry or observation

concepts.label: Constitutional chain and carrier roles

concepts.definition: A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface under existing constitutional authority, not another constitutional layer. It can batch and coordinate work, price proof cost and force close review. Deferred compliance is escrow; sprint close is forensic reconciliation of accumulated work and evidence.

grounding.quote:
A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface.

It is not a new layer in the constitutional chain.

concepts.label: Sprint execution boundary

concepts.definition: The substrate-neutral ambiguity-governance context is urn:stdo:bounded-context:ambiguity-governance. Major ambiguity materially changes architecture, stack, Product boundary, execution/deployment admissibility, public contracts or downstream realization law; micro ambiguity is local choice within governed Design. Lawful Probabilistic Processing is bounded non-human ambiguity handling permitted by declared policy. Human Adjudication is explicit human judgment admitted by authority where policy or risk appetite requires it. Resolved, carried forward, escalated and blocked are handling annotations, distinct from claim verdicts.

grounding.quote:
- **major ambiguity**: ambiguity that materially changes architecture, stack,
  product boundary, execution/deployment admissibility, public contract shape,
  or other downstream realization law
- **micro ambiguity**: local implementation choice that remains inside an
  already-governed design boundary

concepts.label: Ambiguity governance and handling

concepts.definition: Every material product, application, module, graph function, runtime/plugin/public/data surface or capability has an operational lifecycle: intent → requirement → build → assurance → release → deployment → live usage → observed telemetry → retirement. Lifecycle sufficiency is constitutional signal enabling downstream Design or a named unresolved ambiguity, rather than a mandatory detailed release plan for every requirement.

grounding.quote:
intent
  -> requirement
  -> build
  -> assurance
  -> release
  -> deployment
  -> live usage
  -> observed telemetry
  -> retirement

concepts.label: Operational lifecycle sufficiency

concepts.definition: Universal Intake Triage is the single entry route for substantive change, regardless of report label. It diagnoses the affected relation and selects a lawful change class and re-entry scope. The minimum classes are goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe and realization_refactor. Classification is separate from authority to mutate.

grounding.quote:
There is one front door for substantive change.

The intake label does not determine the process class.

concepts.label: Universal intake and change classes

conditions: Assurance or intake requires causal diagnosis of a counterexample on a declared path.
concepts.definition: Counterexample Localization identifies the earliest supported causal frontier: causally minimal violated owner relations or seam coordinates under the declared causal relation, not log or clock order. Its mutually distinguished forms are a unique violated locus, a jointly necessary set of incomparable earliest loci, unresolved alternative frontiers, or indeterminate bounded localization.
exceptions: It does not add a separate pass to every change.

grounding.quote:
A testing counterexample is returned to its earliest supported causal frontier
on the declared path. The frontier contains the causally minimal violated owner
relations or seam coordinates established by the evidence; earliest means
minimal under the declared causal relation, not first in log or clock order.

concepts.label: Counterexample localization

concepts.definition: Computed classification is a reusable intake result. C denotes reproducible facts and declared rule application; J denotes residual semantic/materiality judgment; O denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. Its four reported dimensions are authority traversal, Public delta, accepted-design coverage and rule-determined treatment. These annotations introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, mandatory document or authority.

grounding.quote:
`C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
mandatory document.

concepts.label: Computed classification and treatment

concepts.definition: A consistency gate evaluates closure of a declared change span as a conjunction of all applicable obligations and required judgments or rulings, with no active non-closure condition. Closure is a separate predicate from the fitness of a local artifact.

grounding.quote:
Closure of a declared change span applies
[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to reliance
on its closure evidence, then evaluates the conjunction of all applicable
obligations and required judgments or rulings, with no active non-closure
condition.

concepts.label: Consistency and closure conjunction

concepts.definition: UP-013 binds a Product-outcome-bearing work wave to one explicitly selected unresolved, directly verifiable Product-defined outcome instance and its declared acceptance interval. Material advance, prerequisite readiness, preservation and regression are progress annotations on results. Named bounded prerequisites enable Product obligations; named bounded experiments discriminate stated decisions through stated observations. Outcome meaning belongs to the Product owner; admission bases belong to work-wave authority or its explicitly bounded proxy.

grounding.quote:
Every Product-outcome-bearing work wave identifies one explicitly selected,
unresolved, directly verifiable Product-defined outcome and declares the
acceptance interval for that instance. Product-progress claims and promotion
onto the supported Product path are judged against that same outcome.

concepts.label: Product outcome, prerequisites and experiments

concepts.definition: UP-014 proportionality relates semantic ambiguity removed to effective reasoning complexity introduced. Complexity includes independent concepts and authority surfaces, cross-document joins, exceptions, branches, states, transitions, duplicated representations and decision detail; it is not raw line/artifact count or context-window size. Delivery priority applies this relation to the current outcome, likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependency and feedback-delay cost.

grounding.quote:
Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and
effective reasoning complexity introduced. A method obligation is proportional
when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space justifies the
additional concepts, relations, projections, and evidence that an agent must
hold together to reach a correct decision.

concepts.label: Proportional method and delivery

conditions: A selected outcome, delegated affected cone, concrete execution binding and separately bound assessment and decision authority.
concepts.definition: UP-020 describes outcome-driven construction under an accepted basis: bounded affected relations → selected computational relations → delegated execution and decision authority → construction/self-review → independent live assessment where required → accept/local repair/re-enter/reject → exact accepted checkpoint → next already-authorized bounded action. Constructor, assessor and bounded decision proxy are distinct responsibilities; candidate existence, cone preservation and applied acceptance are distinct claims.

grounding.quote:
accepted governing basis
  -> bounded affected relation set
  -> selected computational relations
  -> delegated execution and decision authority
  -> construction and self-review
  -> independent live-surface assessment where required
  -> accept | local repair | re-enter | reject
  -> exact accepted checkpoint
  -> next already-authorized bounded action

concepts.label: Agentic construction execution

concepts.definition: The bounded causal construction unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering selected behavior while preserving every affected governing relation. Its seams follow support dependencies rather than function, file, module, ticket or document boundaries.

grounding.quote:
the
smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering the selected
behavior while preserving every affected governing relation. Its material seams
follow that condition, not function, file, module, ticket or document boundaries.

concepts.label: Bounded causal construction cone

concepts.definition: Construction assessment tests whether the exact candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation. It returns evidence and a proposed semantic disposition. Applying the disposition is a separate decision on exact subject, basis and mandate. Acceptance binds an exact checkpoint; preservation checkpoints can retain unfinished or unaccepted work without acceptance, promotion or publication. Churn is rejected or superseded construction recorded as history/cost.

grounding.quote:
Assessment evaluates the exact predicate `the candidate closes its declared
cone and preserves every affected governing relation` through the shared
[result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra). It returns evidence and a
proposed semantic disposition. Apply [Dispose](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#dispose)
to the separate decision on that proposal, using this section's construction
conditions and the existing authority's bound mandate.

A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an
existing exact operation grant. Identify its parent or predecessor, included
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location. It is
neither acceptance, promotion nor publication.

concepts.label: Construction disposition and checkpoints

conditions: A consequential transition with actual admission owners.
concepts.definition: UP-021 complete enclosing-relation admission concerns the exact complete material transition, including every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority, currentness or transition can affect or be affected by admission. It distinguishes admission assessment, authorized admission/refusal/effect-free-re-entry decision, actual semantic commit, atomicity, form applicability and observed effects. Design declares supported direct/composite/nested forms and coherent composite bases.

grounding.quote:
Its support universe is
every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority,
currentness or transition can affect or be affected by admission. The owner
independently derives and validates that relation from authoritative inputs;
the shared Support condition governs crossing seams and independence claims.

concepts.label: Complete enclosing-relation admission

concepts.definition: A core interface is a shared contract or carrier materially governing runtime closure, reporting/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution or provider/resolver behavior. A change that can alter how multiple surfaces determine current truth is a core interface change.

grounding.quote:
If changing the interface can alter how multiple surfaces decide "what is true
now," it is a core interface change.

concepts.label: Core interface

concepts.definition: Constitutional migration replaces a load-bearing shared interface. Inside-Out Hard-Break Migration replaces source truth in place on the same implementation line through deliberate breaks and outward repairs. Fundamental Re-Adoption Migration intentionally re-derives on a materially different implementation basis and moves the predecessor sideways as reference material. The affected acceptance path is the outcome's full causal closure; Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are separate claims.

grounding.quote:
- **Inside-Out Hard-Break Migration**: use this when the project remains on the
  same implementation line and the authoritative source truth is being replaced
  in place. The work proceeds from source carrier outward through a sequence of
  deliberate breaks and repairs.
- **Fundamental Re-Adoption Migration**: use this when the rewrite is major and
  the project is intentionally re-deriving itself on a materially different
  implementation basis, such as a new runtime model, carrier model, type
  system, execution substrate, or realization tree. The prior implementation is
  moved sideways and treated as reference material, not live authority.

concepts.label: Constitutional migration and its strategies

concepts.definition: A proof target binds an exact subject, intended property and governing basis to a witness, the nearest weaker excluded property and a falsification condition. Semantic basis comprises constitutional and accepted-design meaning; evidence basis comprises exact artifacts, events, logs, tests and observations; state projection is a current view derived from admitted semantic and evidence bases.

grounding.quote:
Before selecting that witness, bind its relation to the claim, the nearest
weaker excluded property and the falsification condition. Missing these
relations leaves evidence discovery, not closure-grade proof.

- **semantic basis**: constitutional and accepted-design relations defining
  what a claim means;
- **evidence basis**: exact artifacts, events, logs, tests, and observations
  used to evaluate it; and
- **state projection**: a current view derived from admitted semantic and
  evidence bases.

concepts.label: Proof target and semantic/evidence/projection bases

concepts.definition: UP-022 assurance-boundary congruence relates checker, validator, harness or review evidence to the authoritative composite subject and claimed promotion/closure predicate. Generic method qualification uses a fresh competent constructor within a declared capability/context/configuration envelope, ordinary method and authority surfaces, a frozen result, and an independently authorized evaluator with declared basis and comparison predicate.

grounding.quote:
Its support boundary is the authoritative composite subject;
single-carrier evidence leaves unexamined cross-carrier obligations open.

concepts.label: Assurance congruence and method qualification

concepts.definition: Scenarios are Product-owner concrete end-to-end use cases testing operational meaning from intent to realized behavior. Scenario bundles or equivalent ordered testcase sets make feature boundaries, significant sequences and expected intermediate outcomes inspectable. Requirements preserve invariant truth, Design structural choice, and Scenarios operational meaning; these are distinct verification roles.

grounding.quote:
Scenarios are the product-owner layer. They are concrete, end-to-end use cases
that test the chain from intent to realized behavior. Without an adequate
scenario, that layer has not demonstrated the capability.

concepts.label: Scenarios and scenario bundles

concepts.definition: The Product-level test-authority taxonomy belongs to urn:stdo:bounded-context:product-assurance. Design/module conformance tests derive from realization authority and include unit tests and appropriately targeted module integration, negative and fail-closed tests. UAT/acceptance tests derive from constitutional Product/user authority and exercise an isolated composed Product. Harnessed sandbox UAT uses deterministic, fake, recorded or injected workers/results; live sandbox UAT crosses a real configured external worker/tool/agent/service/transport boundary. Authority source is distinct from execution breadth.

grounding.quote:
Authority source is not the same thing as execution breadth. A test may be
small or broad, fast or slow, deterministic or live, but it still derives from
one of two primary authorities:

1. **Design/module conformance tests**
2. **UAT / acceptance tests**

concepts.label: Test authority and execution lanes

concepts.definition: Requirement families describe four kinds of constitutional truth: Capability supplies behavior/function/surface; Constraint/Guarantee bounds behavior through invariants, laws, safety, portability or semantic guarantees; Governance controls lifecycle, authority, visibility, release or operator action; Verification requires tests, evidence, traceability, qualification or forensic surfaces. Categories identify truth ownership, not priority or user-facing status.

grounding.quote:
| **Capability** | A behavior, function, or surface the system must provide | "What can the system do?" |
| **Constraint / Guarantee** | An invariant, law, safety property, portability rule, or semantic guarantee that bounds how the system may behave | "What must always remain true?" |
| **Governance** | A policy or control rule over lifecycle, authority, visibility, release, or operator action | "What governs use and change?" |
| **Verification** | A requirement on tests, evidence, traceability, qualification, or forensic surfaces | "How do we know the claim is true?" |

concepts.label: Requirement categories

concepts.definition: The Reconstruction Litmus tests whether a competent team can derive conformant Intent from Goals, Product from Intent, Requirements from Product, Design from Requirements, and Realization from Requirements plus Design in the selected environment. It tests sufficiency and reconstructable routes, not unique derivation, determinism or repeated reconstruction at every use.

grounding.quote:
This does not mean the derivation is unique. Different designs may satisfy the
same requirements, and different software, human or mixed realizations may
satisfy the same design. The test is sufficiency, not determinism.

concepts.label: Reconstruction sufficiency

grounding.quote:
Profile availability, Product adoption, and execution-scoped activation are
three distinct relations. Inclusion in a selected method cut makes a profile
available. Only Product authority may adopt it. Only an exact authorized work
instruction may activate one bound frame for an actor and subject.

constraints.statement: REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD supplies principles and STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE one optional profile; neither selects, adopts or owns Product bindings. Existing Product authority owns the concrete declaration and every grant. reference_frame_bases is non-empty; every entry locates one accepted declaration, every admitting Goals/Product/requirement/accepted-design/other lawful authority, and its exact governed Product/context/tenant/outcome/other scope. The declaration owns selected frames, method/profile, outcome, actor rules, envelopes, grant requirements, triggers, coverage, result relations and invalidation; the locator neither contains/adopts/restates the binding nor creates authority. Availability, adoption and authorized activation are distinct. Activation does not mutate the overlay; the overlay neither registers agents, permanently assigns frames nor persists temporary configurations. Actor names and broad frames grant no semantic, operational, review, acceptance or disposition authority beyond cited owners and exact activation.

conditions: The governed outcome crosses a chain of Products.

grounding.quote:
Every directed Product-composition edge names its
source and target roles, governing authority and contracts, lifecycle,
evidence boundary, refusal, and invalidation conditions. Common actors,
repositories, files, implementations, outputs, or tool access create no
composition or identity relation.

constraints.statement: The basis records a Product-role map keeping mutable Source Projects, Product Definitions, candidate checkpoints, Release Cuts, released Products, Installs, Artifacts and dependent Products distinct. Each Development Product is a role binding over its exact underlying Install. Every directed composition edge names source/target roles, governing authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal and invalidation conditions. Shared actors, repositories, files, implementations, outputs or tools establish neither composition nor identity.

grounding.quote:
A Product, domain, or runtime carrier also named `Frame` is not included by
nominal match. It remains governed by its bound `WHAT` and `HOW` and may be the
subject or coordinate of an evaluation frame. It enters the collective frame
set only through an explicit frame declaration with the required evaluation
and authority relations.

An adopting Product replaces every placeholder with its own
exact identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results, and invalidation
conditions, then admits that completed declaration under existing authority.

constraints.statement: The copyable PROJECT_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS_TEMPLATE is not authority; adoption replaces every placeholder with exact Product identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results and invalidators, then admits the declaration under existing authority. No schema, axiomatic representation, prompt framework or runtime frame engine is required. A Product/domain/runtime carrier named Frame remains governed by its WHAT/HOW and may be an evaluation subject or coordinate; name matching does not enroll it. Enrollment requires an explicit declaration with required evaluation and authority relations.

conditions: At design admission, for each affected requirement.
Resource quantities are material at the binding's declared boundary.

grounding.quote:
A requirement-to-operation route
alone does not discharge preservation or demonstrate fitness. A tenant cannot
repair an inconvenient requirement by silently changing the common `WHAT`.

constraints.statement: Each affected requirement identifies its realizing operation/invariant, interface preservation obligation and evidence capable of defeating realization. Binding preserves applicable authority, required human decisions, independence, failure and recovery conditions regardless of execution convenience. Context, time, memory, communication, human effort and spend state units and are measured at the declared material boundary. Context fit and attention adequacy retain distinct external evidence conditions; categorical preservation additionally invokes Orthogonal descriptions. A requirement-to-operation route alone proves neither preservation nor fitness. Author identity, actor identity and operation kind remain distinct; a person performing a procedure is not thereby adjudicating. An a_c representation neither chooses an executor nor proves realization conformance through structural validation. Tenants cannot silently alter common WHAT.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited FOUNDATIONS evidence and categorical-preservation contracts are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Goals own the
bounded work wave, ticket state remains ticket authority, and comments remain
non-authoritative commentary.

constraints.statement: what.intent and what.product each locate one canonical constitutional entrypoint; what.specification may locate multiple requirement/specification surfaces. Each canonical how.build_tenants entry has stable identity and root/design/implementation locators. how.common binds a realization law explicitly adopted across more than one tenant. A separate TENANT_REGISTRY.md may be a human companion or generated projection, never a second identity/location authority. ticketing.goals locates the current wave; ticketing.tickets the durable root and at least backlog/active/completed lanes; ticketing.comments the commentary root; ticketing.sprints optionally bounded batch manifests. Goals, ticket-state authority and non-authoritative commentary retain distinct roles.

grounding.quote:
Resolution verifies both locator and expected identity. Moving a definition
requires a locator update but does not change its identity. Replacing content
at the same locator with another definition identity fails closed. When an edge
binds exact immutable Product or release versions, the cited relation and
contracts also carry and verify those identities; the mutable definition
identity cannot substitute for them.

constraints.statement: Directory nesting creates no inheritance, ownership, composition or constitutional override. Each explicit composition entry records product_definition locator, target_definition_id expected from product.definition_id, relation authority defining directed kind/roles/owner/scope/lifecycle/invalidators, and one or more exact consumed governing contracts. Resolution verifies locator and identity; moves require locator updates without identity change; replacement identity at an unchanged locator fails closed. Exact immutable Product/release identities, when bound, must also be carried and verified by relation/contracts and cannot be replaced by mutable definition identity.

conditions: A discovered set claims conformance.

grounding.quote:
- every local disambiguation binds one exact term, target context, complete
  material candidate set, selected concept, authority, basis, and scope, and
  `resolves_to` is a member of `disambiguates` and its referenced resolution
  carrier is congruent with those bindings;

constraints.statement: Every definition validates against its selected released schema; every required URI/fragment resolves within declared workspace/resolver boundaries; definition IDs are globally unique and tenant IDs unique within their overlay. Every governed scope has a resolvable applicable frame basis, with overlaps reconciled by cited authority. Every local disambiguation binds an exact term, target context, complete material candidate set, selected member, authority, basis and scope with congruent resolution carrier. Every material cross-context seam uses explicit import/disambiguation/translation/equivalence, never name matching. Every composition target has the expected ID and every relation/non-empty contract set resolves. No two carriers claim the same Product, tenant, ticket-state or constitutional-relation authority. Draft 2020-12 validation establishes shape only; URI formats are annotations unless asserted. Conformance explicitly checks RFC 3986 URI/reference syntax using assertion-capable validation, then separately resolution, fragments, selected-release identity, cross-file uniqueness, constitutional sufficiency, semantic/cross-context completeness and authority congruence.
constraints.uncertainty: The selected released schemas and resolver configuration are not supplied.

conditions: Exact selected basis.
For collision results, no explicit cross-context relation is supplied.

grounding.quote: | `User` | Product role, human person, identity principal, account, actor, operator, or data subject | unresolved until downstream authority defines or explicitly relates the applicable meanings |

constraints.statement: At minimum, Frame evaluation context and consumer runtime carrier remain distinct without nominal enrollment; Owner specialist family gains no semantic/decision owner authority; immutable Product and mutable Product Definition remain distinct and occurrence context selects; build Tenant supplies no default for hosted/customer/account/runtime/data tenancy; User remains unresolved among Product role, human, principal, account, actor, operator and data subject until downstream authority defines or explicitly relates applicable meanings. Negative cases cover zero candidates, multiple candidates after disambiguation, selection outside the candidate set, context-free glossary fallback, incomplete coordinates, authority/basis mismatch, undeclared loss and invalidated relations. Correct downstream behavior from guessed meaning does not pass semantic conformance.
constraints.uncertainty: No concrete occurrence context or downstream User resolution is supplied.

conditions: Within each derived instruction's declared scope.
exceptions: A concrete form is method law when explicitly accepted by the method as an interoperability boundary.

grounding.quote:
A projected prohibition cannot lose its condition or lawful
alternative even when every source digest is correct. A summary, bootstrap or
index cannot require a stricter or weaker relation by compression. Its
references must be resolvable within the declared actor's access; otherwise the
required meaning is supplied directly.

constraints.statement: Views cannot alter a claim's meaning or authority under its selected constitution. Release authority admits one complete cut; derived/installed/mutable surfaces cannot be partial constitutions or reinterpret owners. Derived guidance preserves applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, decision owners and invalidators, including conditioned prohibitions and lawful alternatives; compression may neither strengthen nor weaken relations. References must be accessible to the declared actor or their required meaning supplied directly. STDO owns normative algebra, authority, abstract state/transition/admissibility/order/evidence laws; consumers own concrete types, schemas, files, tools, runtime/orchestration, tests and executable conformance. Expanding STDO Product scope through an amendment into a tool, engine, runtime, assurance system or consumer realization requires separate explicit human authorization. A recording agent cannot widen a ruling's subject, implication, authority or change class. Only released versions are publication authority; mutable source may author a future cut but cannot silently govern consumers.
constraints.uncertainty: F2/F3/F6 and the faithful-projection contract are referenced but not supplied in full.

exceptions: A concrete path is a requirement-level choice when the path itself is constitutional.
Tenant-local realization becomes governing truth only when ratified in specification.

grounding.quote:
Discarding that context does not rewind A. A new observation can
invalidate a belief or dependent result; it cannot silently change Z or create
permission. Revising Z follows the owning re-entry relation below.

constraints.statement: Downstream success needs adequate upstream meaning and traceable authority. Goals/Product owners choose outcomes; Design chooses any constraint-permitted realization, not a uniquely derived implementation. Every chain link is load-bearing: missing repricing, unowned requirements, ungrounded design or realization without design creates accidental law. Projections are checked against source/current state, add no truth surface and require no universal event replay. Intake selects repricing class/owner; a constitutional gap changes that layer and affected downstream span without inherently requiring new Goals/Intent; unresolved causes may need observation. The workspace persists: current material state and valid authority define A, admitted acceptance constraints define Z, and sufficient context supports the next bounded transition. Context loss does not rewind A; observations can invalidate beliefs/results but cannot change Z or create permission. Temporary Goals focus enters deeper law only through intentional repricing. Requirements encompass all constitutional truth; Design selects concrete placement/mechanism unless constitutionally fixed. Physical layout does not alter shared what versus one-or-more how.build_tenants; tenant-local realization remains derivative until ratified.

conditions: A sprint is used under existing Goals, Intent, Product Definition, Requirements and Design authority.

grounding.quote:
Deferred compliance inside a sprint is escrow, not acceptance. It cannot satisfy
method, release, or product closure until it is paid down, explicitly accepted
under the governing method, or repriced into the appropriate upstream surface.

constraints.statement: A sprint cannot create, supersede, weaken or override constitutional authority. At minimum it declares served goal/wave, upstream authorities, admitted scope, excluded Product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance boundaries, expected change classes, any deferrable local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law and debt paydown/repricing route. Deferral is lawful only while local, visible, bounded and repayable; escrow cannot satisfy method/release/Product closure until paid, explicitly accepted under governing method or repriced upstream. Close may be recommended, not automatically required, on expired timebox, reached scope, review becoming cheaper than iteration, unsafe review uncertainty or gaps outgrowing the sprint. Close compares work/evidence with authority, classifies every gap, accepts compliant work, opens local paydown and escalates drift lawfully; it is not automatic approval. Discovered truth changes are not authorized by the manifest and must be split, escalated, repriced or explicit paydown. Ticket mechanics and domain-specific escrow suitability remain externally owned.
constraints.uncertainty: TICKET_METHOD and UX_METHOD mechanics are not supplied.

conditions: A material unresolved interpretation or major boundary.
exceptions: Risk policy may permit bounded ambiguity handling but cannot override hard stops.

grounding.quote: Ambiguity detection is mandatory. Blocking is policy.

constraints.statement: Unsupported meaning cannot establish a result or permission. Graph/runtime F_D/F_P/F_H shorthands remain in graph-native ODD unless explicitly imported/translated. The chain progressively narrows priority, direction/scope, Product shape/terms, obligation, executable class, structure and local detail, not uniformly. Major ambiguity must always be surfaced and governed, never hidden in informal judgment, precedent or silent model choice. At each major boundary detect/record remaining or introduced major ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, any decision to proceed, and resolved/carried/escalated/blocked handling. Declared Product risk policy determines allowable probabilistic processing and required human adjudication thresholds; convenience does not. Lower risk appetite escalates more, higher permits more bounded processing; both record ambiguity and decision. The goal is sufficient progressive constraint, not eliminating all ambiguity before work.

grounding.quote:
Admissibility and fulfillment of the interrupted task remain separate
predicates: refusal alone does not establish that the intended outcome failed.
An unusable governing
basis or an evaluation outside capability retains its own diagnosis. The stop
label proves neither non-performance nor absence of effects; an undeclared or
uncertain effect needs actual observation before dependent action.

constraints.statement: For 'identified ambiguity is resolved under governing meaning', established resolution is satisfied, established remaining ambiguity falsified, insufficient evidence indeterminate, retaining invalid_basis/out_of_frame diagnoses. Carried/escalated may remain unresolved. Separately, policy-and-authority-lawful handling is satisfied when supported, falsified for demonstrated violation and indeterminate when unsupported, with the same diagnoses; neither settles delivery or extends authority. Typical non-optional hard stops, regardless of risk appetite, include violated invariants/guarantees, absent required authority, missing declared execution capability, undeclared irreversible effects and explicit human-approval gates. Witnessed violation or unmet required authorization falsifies corresponding admissibility; missing evidence leaves it indeterminate. Task fulfillment remains separate, refusal proves neither failure nor non-performance nor no effects, and uncertain/undeclared effects require observation before dependent action.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete external core stop/result contract is not supplied; its expressly stated mappings are retained.

conditions: Lifecycle postures or obligations materially affect the designed thing or Product meaning.
exceptions: An inapplicable phase is permitted when its reason is stated.
A phase may be deferred only by naming the deferment and later owning surface.

grounding.quote:
When the lifecycle signal is missing, downstream design may not fill the gap by
local convention, implementation precedent, prompt prose, or test fixture. It
must reprice the appropriate constitutional surface or carry the ambiguity as
explicit, governed debt.

constraints.statement: Constitutional specification covers more than build shape. PRODUCT.md and requirements provide enough lifecycle signal for Design or explicitly record ambiguity without prescribing every implementation phase. Product names boundary, intended use, release/install, live-use, observability and retirement/supersession posture where material. Requirements state applicable invariants governing build, assurance, release, deployment, use, telemetry, retirement, ownership, source truth, authority and interpretation. Unknown phases receive named Gap:/Unanswered: entries; silence is invalid. Missing signal cannot be supplied by local convention, implementation precedent, prompts or fixtures; reprice the appropriate constitutional surface or carry explicit governed debt.

conditions: Every substantive change.

grounding.quote:
Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

constraints.statement: Begin with intake triage, explicit declared change intent and a lawful constitutional-chain re-entry point.

conditions: Any reported bug, feature, issue, regression, operator finding, release blocker, scenario failure or other intake.

grounding.quote:
Severity records
consequence and priority selects response order within the existing mandate;
neither changes the diagnostic result or grants a repair. A bug list is a view
of this work, not a second construction route.

constraints.statement: Triage determines whether change is substantive, affected Product/scope, lawful class/re-entry, downstream surfaces/evidence needing repricing/re-derivation/re-proof, and release-scope fit or plan repricing. No intake bypasses triage for code, tests or release. Diagnosis binds current subject, outcome, observations and any prediction, distinguishing defective realization, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate prediction and insufficient observation; unresolved causes may select observation before repair. Severity/priority do not alter diagnosis or grant repair. Applicable frames triangulate the same subject/basis through material variables, relations and evidence, retaining alternatives and selecting the smallest sufficient lawful repair scope; exposing frame need not contain the cause and renamed repetition adds no causal evidence. The classification binding includes report, sources, workspace/external observations, retained results and assessment grant, with currentness controlling reuse. Select the smallest sufficient applicable configuration, causal localization where required, without imposing reviewer counts/extra rounds or weakening independence/repair authority.
constraints.uncertainty: External feedback, frame-conjunction and core result contracts are not supplied in full.

conditions: A change is classified for lawful re-entry.

grounding.quote:
Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert that no
upstream constitutional surface is changing.

The absence of a declared change class is process drift.

constraints.statement: goal_reprice changes bounded wave focus, enters Goals and may propagate through Intent/Product/Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence where deeper truth changes. intent_reprice changes direction/scope, enters Intent and propagates through Product/Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence. product_reprice changes Product realization with stable direction, enters Product and propagates through Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence. requirement_reprice changes constitutional truth with stable direction, enters Requirements and propagates through Design/Realisation/Evidence. design_reframe changes structure with stable active Intent/requirements, enters Design and propagates through Realisation/Evidence. realization_refactor changes local implementation/procedure/configuration/attributes with no intended constitutional/structural change, enters only the realized surface and proves no upstream drift. Below-Goals entry requires explicit assertion of unchanged upstream constitutional surfaces; absent declared class is process drift.

conditions: Causal localization is applicable on a Product/design-owner-supplied declared path.

grounding.quote:
A supported unique locus or jointly
necessary set maps to `satisfied` on that predicate. Unresolved alternatives,
an unsupported bounded frontier or a missing required reason maps to
`indeterminate`. Independently admissible evidence defeating the claimed
frontier gives `falsified`; an uninterpretable subject/causal basis gives
`invalid_basis`; diagnosis outside the evaluation scope/capability gives
`out_of_frame`. Apply the [core result contract](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra)
with actual performance and effects. Satisfaction of localization never
overwrites the original counterexample's result or establishes repair success.

constraints.statement: Record subject, basis, frontier form/members, causal evidence, expected relations, observed counterexample and invalidated downstream claims. Do not collapse joint loci into an arbitrary owner or alternatives into joint cause. For the stated-earliest-frontier predicate: supported unique or jointly necessary loci are satisfied; unresolved alternatives, unsupported bounded frontier or missing reason are indeterminate; admissible defeating evidence is falsified; uninterpretable subject/causal basis invalid_basis; out-of-capability/scope out_of_frame. Preserve actual performance/effects and original counterexample result; localization establishes neither repair success nor repair authority. It authorizes no broader tests, compatibility repair, controller or reinterpretation of unchanged upstream meaning; resulting scope/Design change follows existing re-entry.

conditions: Producing or relying on C for an exact requested change and material dependencies.
exceptions: A rename preserves identity only when its owner supplies an identity-preserving relation.

grounding.quote:
C records its producer and procedure
revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes, reproduction relation, unknowns
and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence is an input state.

constraints.statement: Bind request/outcome, targets/effects, grant/lifetime, Product Definition/basis, baseline/available candidate, declared relations, accepted Design, traces, evidence and rules; record producer/procedure revision, inputs/result/scope, source routes, reproduction, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate/evidence is an input state. Authority traversal follows source/ownership/dependency/composition/projection declarations, reporting layers/owners/bases, changed/unchanged/unknown relations, edges and unresolved frontier; root/authority/grant changes remain material even with equal Public bytes, and uncertain materiality remains J. Public delta enumerates the complete relevant serialized universe including helper/generated dependencies, additions/removals and every retained changed typed value/byte with exact before/after; ordinarily rename is removal plus addition. Incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity, missing candidate or unavailable projection leaves affected delta unknown; membership equality proves no value equality. Coverage joins changed bytes/relations to explicit accepted scope/traces/acceptance, distinguishing covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope; filenames/artifacts/digests alone prove none. Treatment uses only declared sufficiently supported rules with owners/premises/consequences and exposes smallest lawful re-entry, action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and lifetime; conflicts/missing premises remain unresolved and settled rules need no invented J.

grounding.quote:
| `the exact relation/member differs from its predecessor` | `changed`: authenticated difference | `satisfied` |
| same delta predicate | `unchanged`: complete comparison establishes equality | `falsified` |
| same delta predicate | `unknown`: missing candidate, incomplete enumeration or unavailable comparison | `indeterminate` |
| `accepted design covers this exact changed relation` | `covered`: current accepted scope, trace and acceptance establish coverage | `satisfied` |
| same coverage predicate | `missing` or `outside-scope`: complete evidence establishes absence or exclusion from accepted scope | `falsified` |
| same coverage predicate | `missing`, `stale` or `ambiguous`: support does not decide current coverage | `indeterminate` |

constraints.statement: Declared comparison/coverage scopes may include any supported state, including no change/no candidate. Difference predicate: authenticated changed=satisfied, complete equality= falsified, unavailable/incomplete comparison=indeterminate. Coverage predicate: current accepted scope/trace/acceptance= satisfied; complete absence/exclusion= falsified; undecided missing/stale/ambiguous support=indeterminate. Both retain invalid_basis for unusable basis and out_of_frame for evaluation scope/capability, distinct from Design exclusion; missing reason is indeterminate while retaining independent counterevidence. C/J/O and classes remain annotations/treatment choices; treatment tests named rule premises and applied ruling has a separate decision predicate. Nonconformance alone does not change governing law: reject/locally repair within grant if contract is sufficient; re-enter actual owner for explicitly desired changed meaning or established insufficiency, with sufficient declared premises for C and unresolved necessity/meaning as J, reserved decisions O. Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance/promotion; an existing bounded grant may permit a cheapest discriminator or first candidate without conformance claims. Correct mistaken routes at smallest affected owner. Reuse checks current request/candidate/basis/root-owner/projection/design-trace-acceptance/rule/configuration/evidence; refresh affected results before reliance, retain predecessor/successor, cause/attempted subject/effects/surviving facts/J dependencies, and recompute wider frontier where independence is unproved.
constraints.uncertainty: External Currentness and ticket-carrier/J/O continuity details are unresolved.

conditions: Closing a declared change span or reconciling a code/test mismatch during ticketed work.

grounding.quote:
A review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change does not
discharge a missing required predicate in that conjunction.

constraints.statement: No gate closes with internally inconsistent affected active surfaces. Closure requires supported evidence and all applicable obligations/judgments/rulings without active non-closure: upstream suffices for downstream, artifacts do not contradict active upstream truth, and tests/qualification prove active intended behavior rather than stale precedent. Events, aggregates, artifacts or status changes cannot discharge missing predicates. Shared Result governs conjunction; ticket state/reuse carrier and claim applicability remain externally owned. Implementation behavior is evidence, not test authority; mismatches re-enter through the admitted ticket, triage and governing requirement/design/module/graph/carrier/closure surface.
constraints.uncertainty: Ticket-local test authority, shared conjunction and workspace applicability contracts are not supplied.

conditions: A Product-outcome-bearing work wave.
exceptions: An explicitly Product-defined assurance capability is evaluated as Product behavior.
One artifact may be Product output for one claim and evidence for another when roles are separately declared.

grounding.quote:
Acceptance exhausts only that instance and its declared
acceptance interval. It does not discharge an enduring guarantee, recurring
obligation, or broader Product family beyond the accepted instance. Further
work against the accepted instance is preservation, a named bounded
prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or a new change requiring lawful
repricing; it is not additional progress against the accepted instance.

constraints.statement: Judge progress/promotion against the same selected unresolved outcome. For material-advance predicate, established advance=satisfied; prerequisite-only, preservation-only and observed regression=falsified; unmeasured/undecidable movement=indeterminate with basis/scope diagnoses. Readiness/preservation have separate predicates and can be satisfied without progress; only material advance projects Product progress. Prerequisites name the enabled obligation and stay bounded. Owning acceptance exhausts that exact instance/interval as a selector of later progress while preserving witnesses for regression/preservation and leaving enduring/recurring/broader obligations intact. Further work is preservation, a bounded prerequisite for another admitted outcome or lawful repricing. Selecting another already-defined unresolved outcome is Goals/sequencing; changing/adding outcome meaning/scope re-enters Product. Completed proof, matrix, inventory, design-method artifact, coverage ledger or test suite cannot itself select/enlarge/replace the outcome. Outcome success is necessary delivery evidence, not complete Product/release closure.

conditions: Material realization growth or prerequisite/experiment admission, renewal, retention or promotion.
exceptions: Independent parallel work may continue under its own admitted basis.
Further material work after exhaustion requires a new owning-authority or explicitly bounded proxy admission.

grounding.quote:
Ended authority cannot be renewed by repair, continuation, evidence, active
ticket or run state, or prior admission; further material work requires a new
admission by the owning authority or its explicitly bounded proxy.

constraints.statement: Growth derives authority only from the selected unresolved outcome, an admitted named bounded prerequisite or an admitted named bounded decision-discriminating experiment. Their provisional grants neither enlarge/select outcomes, authorize downstream work, confer promotion/closure nor waive applicable Prime/design/safety/authority/release law. Owning wave authority or bounded proxy records admission/renewal in durable Goals/ticket authority with bound and exhaustion/falsification conditions. Experiment observation/decision resolution, prerequisite discharge or outcome acceptance exhausts the corresponding basis; other admitted terminal conditions, rejection, withdrawal, supersession, repricing or falsification also end it. Ticket/contract drafting or validation, active status, prior admission, repairs and continuation do not renew it. Retention as supported behavior/evidence/regression protection/donor material grants no growth. Consumer-owned salvage re-adopts only explicit semantics, not enclosing authority/dependencies/completion/work-selection power. Regression or unresolved gaps block affected-path promotion until repaired, repriced or owner-accepted; independent work cannot be counted as this outcome's progress.

conditions: A material method burden or delivery-priority choice.
exceptions: One coherent constraint family may be justified once by its owning law, without per-clause rationale fields, receipts or repeated audits.

grounding.quote:
Rival authority, uncertainty
over failure classification, and evidence uncertainty count only where they
leave materially distinct admissible semantic, authority, outcome, or
acceptance interpretations. They measure or evidence the same interpretation
space removed; they are not independent proportional benefits.

constraints.statement: Each constraint identifies ambiguity removed and contracts enough admissible interpretation space to justify added complexity. Authority/failure/evidence uncertainties count only as materially distinct interpretations, not separate benefits. Detailed algebra/Ontology/IACS/Prime/views can be proportional; short duplicative truth surfaces can be disproportionate. Divergent implementation paths/states/tests/reviews/joins are counterfactual evidence of alternatives, not another numerator; a bounded symbolic model resolving them within capacity is proportional, while prior design removing none is not. Duplicated truth, extra reconciliation or expanded reasoning without material ambiguity reduction is disproportionate; existing obligations should absorb detail where ownership/meaning survive. Repeated acquisition/context/hashing/activation/status/review/evidence work serves an identified change/decision/assurance need; reuse requires applicability/invalidation, repetition proves neither validity nor independence. Material operational assumptions are qualified under UP-019, without universal quotas/separate accounting carriers. Priority considers outcome, likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependencies and feedback delay; probability waives no authority/integrity/safety/retained release claim/hard stop. Default priority exposes/advances the smallest supported Product path and highest-value likely failures. Displacing defensive/prerequisite work identifies claim, evidence, bounded effort, return condition and expected consequence; no fixed global schedule follows.
constraints.uncertainty: UP-019 operational qualification is referenced but not supplied.

conditions: Construction is delegated under a selected outcome, affected cone, execution binding and separately bound assessment/decision authority.
exceptions: Optional profiles add duties only where adopted.
Independent live assessment is required only where the governing binding requires it.

grounding.quote:
These choices bind outcome-driven construction to its actual
executor and observation boundary without selecting a worker topology or
internal search. A human, machine or mixed binding remains subject to the
same affected obligations; an optional profile adds duties only where adopted.

constraints.statement: Governing authorities select outcome, delegation and required independent assessment. Candidate bytes do not establish cone preservation; continuation retains useful work and observes current state/unresolved effects; bounded steps preserve affected outer relations. Construction or passing assessment cannot appoint acceptance authority. The source-described sequence binds actual executor and observation boundary without prescribing worker model, prompt, tools, search, process topology, repository layout or runtime. Human, machine and mixed bindings retain the same affected obligations.
constraints.uncertainty: The work/recovery specialization is not supplied.

conditions: A proposed bounded action.
Design-module input laws apply only where DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD applies.
constraints.statement: Execution intake binds selected outcome/prerequisite/admitted experiment, bounded affected relations/invariants, accepted transformation-admission relations, computational/common-library dispositions, construction/assessment authority and upstream re-entry conditions. Acquire constraint surface/material subject for current A, admitted Z, bounded transition and result observations. Applicable UP-017 bounded-frame conservation, UP-016 admission completeness, UP-018 invariant reconstruction and UP-019 computational projection supply these inputs; this consumption creates no second design package.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced transformation and design-module laws are not supplied.

conditions: Selecting an execution unit.

grounding.quote:
Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
does not block the bounded claim.

constraints.statement: Apply the source-referenced Support condition to the smallest coherent behavior-delivering cone preserving every affected governing relation. Material seams follow causal support, not organizational or file boundaries. Record unrelated external incompleteness as repricing input; it does not block the bounded claim.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete Support condition is external to the supplied sections.

conditions: Construction, assessment or delegated routine acceptance.
exceptions: Direct-human acceptance still applies wherever Product or release law requires it.
Direct constructor/Writer entry is permitted when one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake and operation grant.

grounding.quote:
Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
at a boundary owned elsewhere.

constraints.statement: Constructor owns implementation/self-review. Where independence supports promotion, assessor evaluates exact live realization, computational binding, authority paths, proof and installed subject; constructor summary is insufficient. Configuration binds actors under independence conditions without prescribed count. Governing authority declares bounded proxy acceptance: preservation acceptance, local repair, rejection and advancing already-authorized actions are permitted within delegation, never Product/requirement/authority/accepted-Design changes, which re-enter their owner. Accepted basis/cone/decision envelope/re-entry conditions remove any need for human ceremony at every transition without waiving reserved human decisions. Direct Writer entry needs no Executive solely for appointment; coordination is selected for material contexts/authority/capability/independence, not role names. One bounded grant may cover declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; record actual role changes in existing carrier, with no new grant or rehash solely for status. Material operation/subject/territory/authority/validity changes require affected binding resolution before effect; Executive mutation restrictions remain.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed independence, execution-contract, carrier and Executive restriction laws are not supplied.

conditions: Assessment of the exact candidate's cone closure and preservation claim.

grounding.quote:
| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | `satisfied` |
| `local_repair`, demonstrated counterexample | a demonstrated defect defeats the claim while the governing relation remains coherent | `falsified` |
| `local_repair`, inadequate proof | missing or defective proof leaves the candidate claim undecided; the evidence supports a local proof repair | `indeterminate` |
| `re_enter`, defeated candidate | the intended candidate cannot satisfy an interpretable current contract without an owning-layer change | `falsified` |
| `re_enter`, unusable governing basis | the governing requirements cannot supply a coherent interpretation for this assessment | `invalid_basis` |
| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | `falsified` |
| any proposed disposition, missing required reason or support | its qualified condition above is not established and no independently admissible evidence decides the candidate predicate | `indeterminate` |

constraints.statement: Accept proposal with established cone preservation maps to satisfied. Local repair with demonstrated defect/coherent law maps to falsified; inadequate proof leaving implementation undecided with supported local proof repair maps to indeterminate. Re-entry for candidate inability to satisfy interpretable contract without owner change maps to falsified; incoherent governing requirements maps to invalid_basis. Reject for violation or undisposed competing truth maps to falsified. Missing reason/support with no independent deciding evidence maps to indeterminate, retaining raw label as non-deciding support and any counterevidence or scope/basis diagnosis. Governing-requirement coherence is admission; candidate/Design alignment is evaluated, so contradictory Design need not invalidate interpretable requirements, and proof falsification need not falsify implementation. Supported cause and authority select remedy; core verdict alone neither selects remedy nor prohibits useful authorized repair. Candidate availability is separate. Applied Dispose decision is separate, may satisfy lawful rejection without proving a candidate counterexample, and never overwrites assessment.
constraints.uncertainty: The full external Dispose and core conjunction contracts are not supplied.

conditions: A bounded action or repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary.

grounding.quote:
The method sets no rejection-count threshold,
mandatory review-round count, or review state machine; it prohibits repeating
an unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close it.

constraints.statement: Global correctness preserves every global relation affected by the action, without proving the whole Product in every local action. Repeated rejection at unchanged boundaries requires reassessing frame altitude, causal cone, common components, Design-versus-code placement and authority sufficiency. No rejection threshold, review-round count or state machine is prescribed; unchanged failed construction cannot be repeated as though iteration itself closes it.

conditions: A reviewable transition and selection of proof.
For durability proof, incidental process-state loss is a material counterexample.

grounding.quote:
A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.

constraints.statement: Transition evidence identifies exact candidate, affected relations, changed realization paths, added/removed authority paths, retained/open seams, focused/required integration proof, explicit non-changes, proposed disposition and separate applied decision. Consumers choose representation; this read model adds no specification, Design or admission authority. Focused proof binds source obligations, assertion/execution dependencies, supported exclusions, new cases and mandatory gates using change-impact/risk laws; weaker cheap falsification cannot close a stronger claim. Retained evidence keeps its original subject and required applicability relation; compare selection/reassessment cost together. Whole-candidate qualification remains at its boundary or moves earlier for affected risk, uncertain impact or mandatory gates. Material cross-process authority requires destroying/excluding incidental authority and comparing reconstructed semantic outcomes, not only same-process tests.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced evidence-retention, risk-selection and assertion contracts are not supplied.

conditions: Checkpointing, continuation or recovery.
exceptions: The next already-authorized bounded action may begin without renewed human approval.

grounding.quote:
If a proposed recovery instead discards or rebuilds work, identify why repair
of retained work is insufficient, which obligations and evidence survive,
which causal assumptions change and which existing operation grant permits
that effect. Reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction.

constraints.statement: Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint without widening outcome/cone. Preservation under an existing exact grant records predecessor, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence, without acceptance/promotion/publication. Continuation checks Currentness over the continuing workspace and retains applicable partial work/evidence; restart does not select original-A rebuild. Discard/rebuild requires why repair is insufficient, surviving obligations/evidence, changed causal assumptions and an existing grant permitting effects. Accepted material movement is UP-013 progress; rejected/superseded work is churn, proving neither movement nor noncompliance alone. Hidden distance revises forecasts, not automatically implementation regress; paperwork/code/tests/commits/reviews alone prove no progress. Consumers may derive projections, not a prescribed numerical algorithm. The protocol is defeated by unreconstructable execution context, constructor-summary substitution for required independent live evidence, proxy overreach, unrelated incompleteness blocking a closed cone, same-process proof of materially cross-process authority, or rejected activity reported as accepted progress.

conditions: Admission or reliance on established transition facts.
exceptions: Participating owners may use a design-declared coherent composite basis instead of identical bases.
Internal evaluation order and lawful reuse are implementation-owned.

grounding.quote:
Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis
identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance after
preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor and
currentness law for that basis or re-enters derivation and validation without
effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a design-declared coherent
composite basis. Independently valid judgments without that relation cannot
establish admission; retain the basis or join diagnosis under the map below.

constraints.statement: Every owner independently derives/validates complete material participants/joins from authoritative inputs, retaining support across seams and required independence. Material mutation, rollback, authority/basis change, expired validity and actual trust-boundary crossing require applicable validation before reliance/effect, including unchanged claimed facts crossing trust boundaries. Assertions of completeness/validity/prior success/authority are not proof; reuse preserves owner responsibility and independent judgment. Bind one exact valid/current basis through admission; advancement after preflight requires declared predecessor/currentness commit condition or effect-free re-derivation. All participants/joins validate before any effect; no subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth. One semantic commit admits complete transition or none on failure/interruption, with no prescribed mechanism/count. All supported direct/composite/nested forms preserve this law; partial results and competing same-scope paths cannot replace owner validation. Fresh reconstruction/replay over the same basis reproduces enclosing relation, basis identity and complete semantic outcome/refusal exactly.

conditions: Evaluation of the exact candidate against the complete declared transition relation at current authoritative basis.

grounding.quote:
| complete relation, every applicable condition and material join established | `satisfied`; supports the assessed `admitted` outcome, not proof of commit |
| forged identity/authority, stale predecessor, defeated grant, omitted required participant or join, or another demonstrated violation of an interpretable relation | `falsified`; retain the specific refusal/re-entry reason |
| unresolved enclosing ambiguity, missing support, undecided currentness or missing required reason | `indeterminate`; no guessed completeness or authority |
| uninterpretable/contradictory governing subject or basis, including mixed owner bases with no interpretable admitted composite | `invalid_basis`; retain the mixed-basis refusal diagnosis |
| evaluation outside its bound scope or capability | `out_of_frame`; the wider obligation remains open |

constraints.statement: Preserve admitted/refused/effect-free-re-entry domain outcomes separately. Complete established relation/conditions/joins=satisfied, supporting assessed admission but not commit; demonstrated forged identity/authority, stale predecessor, defeated grant, omitted participant/join or other interpretable violation=falsified with reason; ambiguity/missing support/undecided currentness/missing reason=indeterminate; uninterpretable or contradictory subject/basis, including incoherent mixed owners=invalid_basis; outside scope/capability=out_of_frame with wider obligation open. For interpretable composite bases, incompatible joins are falsified and missing join evidence indeterminate; coherent different bases are not failure. Conjunction retains authenticated failures alongside uncovered/invalid contributions. Supported arbitrary predecessors and direct/composite/nested forms share the contract. 'Form outside supported boundary' is a separate applicability predicate: supported exclusion=satisfied, included case=falsified, unresolved applicability=indeterminate, with basis/scope diagnoses; not_applicable cannot replace missing admission assessment. Authorized admission/refusal/re-entry decisions have a separate decision predicate and no authority is granted by assessment.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete external result/conjunction algebra remains unavailable.

conditions: Refusal, publication, interruption or observation of transition effects.

grounding.quote:
Admission satisfaction, actual semantic commit and atomicity are separate
claims. `Without effect` is a required refusal observation: report `not_started`
only when no requested transition effect began, and retain observed `partial`,
`reverted` or `unknown` effects on their actual boundaries. An observed subset
falsifies complete-or-none publication even if preflight admission satisfied;
unobserved publication remains unresolved and requires observation before
dependent re-entry. A refusal label cannot erase an effect that occurred.

constraints.statement: Admission satisfaction, actual semantic commit and atomicity are distinct. Required effect-free refusal must be observed: not_started only if no requested effect began; retain partial/reverted/unknown effects at actual boundaries. Observed subset publication falsifies complete-or-none even after satisfied preflight; unobserved publication is unresolved and requires observation before dependent re-entry. Refusal cannot erase effects. The law is defeated by asserted rather than derived completeness, omitted relevant participants/joins/seams, unidentified/stale/incoherent basis, advancing currentness without commit condition/effect-free re-entry, effects before full validation, exposed subsets on interruption/failure, differing reconstruction or competing same-scope authority.

conditions: Every admission owner and supported boundary declared by accepted Design, within the supported input/state/operating/threat model.
exceptions: Unsupported forms require Design-grounded not_applicable dispositions.
Representative atomic-failure observations suffice only with Design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface.
Excluded threats do not create acceptance predicates or defensive-work duties; scope expansion returns to the owner.

grounding.quote:
For an indivisible commit unit, the atomic test establishes that boundary and
observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation
failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure evidence. A
standing claim is false if an owner or supported boundary is omitted, a
materially distinct partial-failure boundary lacks an observation or declared
coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or manufactured refusal, or fresh
reconstruction does not compare the complete semantic result.

constraints.statement: Each case returns the admission/applicability/publication predicate actually tested through its owning map, not another conjunction or inferred no-effect. Observe: direct complete relation derived/validated/admitted once; every supported composite/nested constituent and owner obeying the same law without competing/weaker paths; reachable forgery of identity/membership/equality/authority refused without effect, with exclusions owned rather than based on helper limitations; enclosing ambiguity refused without effect; stale input refused and preflight advancement causing effect-free re-entry; incoherent composites retaining invalid_basis or interpretable defeated/undecided join result, withholding admission and checking no effect; competing same-scope authority unable to establish transition; fresh reconstruction and exact replay reproducing relation/basis/outcome/refusal. After validation, observe failure/interruption at every materially distinct subset-exposing publication boundary and fresh reconstruction of complete-or-none. Indivisible units require boundary establishment and failures immediately on both sides; final-participant validation failure is not post-validation atomic evidence. Omitted owners/boundaries, uncovered partial failures, weaker helpers/manufactured refusals or incomplete semantic comparison defeat standing claims.
constraints.uncertainty: Actual accepted Design, supported models and qualification observations are not supplied.

conditions: A change alters a load-bearing contract, carrier, resolver, provider, projection/closure law or another shared interface depended on by multiple surfaces.
exceptions: Explicitly disjoint compatibility scopes retain lawful latitude.
Bounded Product-slice proof follows the separate path-relative promotion rule.

grounding.quote:
- change the authoritative core contract first
- ban bridge code for that contract family as an authoritative surface
- audit every producer and every consumer of the impacted interface
- migrate each producer and consumer to the new contract
- chase every downstream effect until no superseded closure law remains
- run complete migration-closure proof only after the migration wave is
  complete; bounded Product-slice proof remains governed by the path-relative
  promotion rule below
