constraints.statement: Treat affected shared interfaces as constitutional migration, not incremental local patching. Change authoritative core first; prohibit authoritative bridge code for that family; audit and migrate every producer/consumer; follow every downstream effect until superseded closure law is gone; complete migration proof follows the completed wave. Mixed producers, differing runtime/reporting/topology carriers, silent authoritative aliases, independent projection truth and green tests over split architecture cannot be declared complete. Human Product authority selects fundamental re-adoption; these preservation premises do not imply automatic deletion.
constraints.uncertainty: Later live-surface supersession and legacy-classification sections referenced here are outside the supplied excerpt.

conditions: Selecting between lawful feasible migration strategies.
exceptions: The evolution presumption does not require unsafe or constitutionally inadmissible predecessor continuation.
Product authority may explicitly supersede an implementation or public mechanism.

grounding.quote:
Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit selection by the human authority
owning the affected Product boundary. The selection compares re-adoption with
bounded evolution across Product value, feedback latency, authority risk,
reversibility, total cost, and retained predecessor semantics. It also states a
bounded abort or re-entry condition. Implementation scale or architectural
preference alone does not select re-adoption.

constraints.statement: Inside-out applies to same-line in-place source-truth replacement; fundamental re-adoption to intentional major re-derivation on materially different runtime/carrier/type/substrate/realization basis, with predecessor as reference only. If both strategies are lawful/feasible and a working predecessor can reach the outcome without competing/ambiguous authority, supported-path bounded evolution is a rebuttable presumption conserving accepted semantics/feedback. Evolution involving a core interface uses inside-out and is not a third strategy. Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit affected-Product human selection comparing value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained semantics, plus bounded abort/re-entry. Scale or architectural preference alone does not select it.

conditions: Promotion of an affected Product outcome during either migration strategy.
exceptions: Residual superseded-family material may be deferred only outside the promoted path under the expressly stated non-authority/disjoint-scope, non-falsification and bounded-disposition conditions.

grounding.quote:
Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims. An
intermediate Product outcome may be promoted while its enclosing migration
remains open only when the outcome's acceptance path has singular authority and
the residual implementation satisfies the deferment rule above. That promotion
does not close the migration or waive its final retirement criteria. The
slice's identity and acceptance criteria derive from Product plus every causally
applicable live requirement, accepted design relation, and retained predecessor
claim. Ticket or review wording cannot narrow that authority away.

constraints.statement: No proxy/partial implementation substitutes for the new contract in acceptance and no bridge/fallback remains silently authoritative. Promotion requires one unambiguous governing authority across full causal closure: every admitted entrypoint, producer, consumer, resolver, fallback, shared state, event, projection and proof surface capable of changing/interpreting/closing the outcome. A successful trace alone is insufficient; admissibility of the same request/fact/identity/state/projection to old and new authorities blocks promotion. Residuals outside that path must be explicitly non-authoritative for the outcome or govern explicitly specified disjoint Product/compatibility scope with deterministic routing, cannot falsify current/retained claims, and retain bounded migration/qualification/release disposition. Tests detect leaks/prove claims, not plan migration. Intermediate acceptance neither closes migration nor waives retirement; Product/live requirements/accepted Design/retained predecessor claims define the slice and tickets cannot narrow them. Migration activity does not renew an accepted slice's exhausted growth; admitted removal/demotion/closure proof may continue within bound without progress claims, while further producer/consumer growth needs a still-live UP-013 basis.

conditions: A shared contract or carrier materially governs current truth across multiple surfaces.

grounding.quote:
- runtime closure
- reporting or status truth
- topology or frame progression
- proof or qualification outcome
- event or projection semantics
- identity or binding resolution
- provider or resolver behavior

constraints.statement: Core-interface applicability includes runtime closure, reporting/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification outcomes, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution and provider/resolver behavior. Altering how multiple surfaces decide current truth triggers core-interface change classification.

conditions: Every core interface migration.

grounding.quote:
Temporary scaffolding is lawful only if it is explicitly non-authoritative and
scheduled for removal before closure.

constraints.statement: Explicitly declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint Product/compatibility scope and deterministic routing; new authoritative contract; superseded contract/surface; new authoritative closure law; full old/new producer and consumer sets; and every derivative projection/report/status/proof surface. Classify every old path as remove, replace, re-authorize or temporary scaffolding. Scaffolding must be explicitly non-authoritative and scheduled for removal before closure.

conditions: A core interface migration.
exceptions: An explicit compatibility feature retained in the live Product is lawful only when intentionally specified, explicitly bounded and clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth.

grounding.quote:
The only lawful exception is an explicit compatibility feature retained as part
of the live product. In that case the compatibility path must be:

- intentionally specified
- explicitly bounded
- clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth

constraints.statement: No authoritative compatibility alias, silent fallback identity law, bridge accepted as new contract, old authoritative reader/writer for an outcome governed by the new contract, or proxy/partial interface standing between old/new truth as completion is permitted. Apply the explicit live-compatibility exception with its stated boundaries, alongside the source's path-relative promotion conditions.

conditions: Runtime, reporting, status, topology or proof views of the authoritative carrier.

grounding.quote:
A different carrier or closure law that permits conflicting
determinations, a view that independently closes an open source, or a view
retaining superseded closure law leaves the migration incomplete, even when the
authoritative carrier itself can close.

constraints.statement: Faithful projection requires one governing closure relation across all listed views. Conflicting carriers/closure laws, a view closing an open source independently, or retained superseded closure law leave migration incomplete even if the authoritative carrier can close.
constraints.uncertainty: The external faithful-projection contract is not supplied.

conditions: Inside-out hard-break migration.
exceptions: Isolated non-authoritative downstream exploration may occur before source admission, but cannot land in public entrypoints.

grounding.quote:
- a downstream projection ticket must not close while the source-carrier ticket
  it depends on is still open
- dependency direction must reflect this order explicitly so the ticket set
  exposes the migration wave from source truth to downstream read models

constraints.statement: Proceed outward from the new authoritative carrier. Discover the full best-guess interface family before using proof as closure evidence, including producers, consumers, projections, prompts, reports, wrappers, replay, ingest, bootstrap and proof paths. Authoritative producer/carrier work precedes downstream consumer/projection/prompt/dossier/report/review hardening. Exploration cannot enter public runtime/projection/prompt/report/proof entrypoints before carrier publication/admission. Downstream projection tickets cannot close while their source-carrier dependency is open; explicit dependency direction must show this wave.

conditions: Each break in an inside-out migration wave.
exceptions: Explicitly specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping Product/compatibility scopes may coexist while migration remains open.
Newly discovered affected interfaces leave the existing wave only through explicit upward repricing.

grounding.quote:
1. publish or admit the new deepest authoritative source carrier
2. deliberately sever one old authoritative seam
3. keep that seam broken
4. repair outward from source truth to consumers, then projections, then
   prompts/reports, then proof surfaces
5. run negative proof that the severed seam is rejected rather than merely
   unused

constraints.statement: The wave is ordered breaks, not permission for ambiguous dual authority over the same request/fact/identity/state/projection. For each break publish/admit deepest new carrier, sever an old authoritative seam, keep it broken, repair consumers then projections then prompts/reports then proof, and negatively prove rejection rather than mere non-use. Tests can discover missed interfaces but do not replace inventory. Newly discovered affected interfaces remain in-wave absent upward repricing. Re-enabling severed seams through wrappers/fallbacks/projections/prompts is a migration defect.

conditions: Core-interface migration proof.
exceptions: Exact intermediate Product-slice proof is permitted by the path-relative promotion rule but cannot establish migration closure.

grounding.quote:
- per-break proof must show the severed old seam is rejected or fails closed
  before downstream hardening can count as progress

constraints.statement: Complete migration-closure proof is invalid while producers/consumers are split across old/new contracts. Bridge-dependent passing tests and green local tests cannot override split architecture. Complete closure proof follows the migration, while each break must already prove the old seam rejected or fail-closed before downstream hardening counts as progress.

conditions: Claiming completion across the declared affected migration scope.
exceptions: Retained superseded mechanisms may serve justified distinct supported responsibilities.
An enduring required cold-reconstruction route or independent test oracle needs no invented expiry.
Retirement within a closed affected cone need not await unrelated whole-Product closure.

grounding.quote:
A required cold reconstruction route or independent
test oracle may serve an enduring distinct obligation without an invented
expiry. Where an obligation survives replacement, identify its surviving owner;
where it has no governing basis, no replacement guard is required. Retirement
inside a closed affected cone does not await unrelated whole-Product closure.

constraints.statement: Completion requires every authoritative producer/consumer using the new contract, retired superseded authority except justified distinct responsibilities, downstream projections without competing truth, one closure law across runtime/reporting/topology/proof, and no temporary scaffolding in acceptance. Otherwise the wave remains active. Retention bears proof: each mechanism names current supported obligation, owner, purpose, execution scope and material cost; temporary compatibility/comparison has expiry/removal trigger. Existing tests, oracle labels or nominal demotion do not justify duplicate production responsibility. Surviving obligations name surviving owners; no governing basis means no required replacement guard. Accepted slices name what they close and keep enclosing migration visibly open, without claiming migration/qualification/release closure.

conditions: Selecting an operative release cut or describing active constitutional/shared realization surfaces.

grounding.quote:
Active constitutional and shared realization surfaces
describe current truth by role, boundary and status rather than release-line
branding. Release criteria, publication and advancement remain Release Method's
decisions.

constraints.statement: Release identities and selector/consumer adoption bind an exact operative cut distinct from discovery. Its immutable identity bounds the then-accepted feature set in release metadata/evaluation. Active constitutional/shared realization surfaces express current role/boundary/status rather than release-line branding. Release Method retains criteria, publication and advancement decisions.
constraints.uncertainty: RELEASE_METHOD selection and identity rules are not supplied.

conditions: Constitutional claim evidence.

grounding.quote:
The claim owner supplies the property and required scope; the
authorized evaluator supplies evidence, not a substitute target.

constraints.statement: A witness establishes only its bound property; evidence changes do not author meaning or permission. Construction assurance owns obligation→assertion→observation→supported conclusion; Contract application binds the selected operation and Faithful projection its views. UP-001 selects explicit targets/weaker-property exclusion, UP-008 separate semantic/evidence/projection bindings, and UP-022 assurance-boundary/fresh-constructor/exposure conditions. Claim owner supplies property/scope, evaluator evidence rather than replacement target.
constraints.uncertainty: External foundational and transformation contracts are referenced, not supplied.

conditions: A load-bearing proof.

grounding.quote:
Packaging, syntax, compilation, file presence, invocation, or local behavior
must not substitute for semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release, or
end-to-end proof merely because the weaker property is easier to measure.

constraints.statement: Before witness selection bind exact subject, intended property, governing basis, witness-to-claim relation, nearest weaker excluded property and falsification condition; missing relations leave discovery rather than closure-grade proof. State supported necessity/sufficiency, required conjunction and distinguishing observation. Interpretive fidelity and observed checker behavior remain separate obligations. Easier packaging/syntax/compilation/presence/invocation/local behavior cannot substitute for semantic, authority, installed, release or end-to-end proof.

grounding.quote:
Evidence or view changes do not themselves change meaning. Semantic change
requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance; a
broad digest may conservatively invalidate review without proving that every
semantic relation changed.

constraints.statement: Keep claim-defining constitutional/accepted-design basis, exact evaluation evidence, and derived current state projection distinct. Apply Currentness to verdicts and faithful projection to views. Evidence/view changes do not change meaning; semantic change requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance. Broad digest changes may conservatively invalidate review without proving every semantic relation changed.

conditions: Reliance on assurance or a mechanical enforcement/generalized claim.
exceptions: An unobserved enforcement claim may be explicitly downgraded to a planned property.

grounding.quote:
A claim's quantifier, population, and scope cannot exceed its evaluated
evidence. Generalizing a local defect requires a declared inference relation,
the relevant comparable population, explicit counterexample treatment, and
governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict
until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn, or requalified.

constraints.statement: Assurance supports the authoritative composite subject; weaker/different or per-carrier evidence cannot close unexamined composite obligations. Mechanical enforcement names executable/reproducible predicate and an observed witness reachable through the ordinary declared assurance path; planned/specification-only harnesses are not observed verification and absent predicate/witness leaves the claim open or explicitly planned. Quantifier/population/scope cannot outrun evidence. Generalizing a local defect requires declared inference, comparable population, counterexample treatment and governing evidence; later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until supersession/withdrawal/requalification. Changed guidance is qualified against source-derived behavior including permissions/exclusions/invalidators; native-use claims require ordinary actors using declared entry/context. Digests/index generation prove identity/structure, not fidelity/usability. Mechanical/operational claims require their own executable observations and applicable UP-019 workloads/assumptions; semantic agreement cannot replace them.
constraints.uncertainty: The applicable operational qualification law and ordinary assurance configurations are not supplied.

conditions: Generic method-sufficiency qualification.
Withhold material reference exposure before freeze wherever earlier exposure compromises reconstructive independence.
exceptions: A separately held applicable reference outcome, if any, is optional non-authoritative evidence; reference equivalence is required only when governing basis requires it.
Lawful alternative constructions can satisfy semantic conformance with declared evidence.

grounding.quote:
Any post-exposure revision is a declared intervention and is either a method
constituent with its qualification boundary or a new qualification subject. It
cannot retroactively make the original frozen construction pass. This law
prescribes no actor type or count, review-round count, engine, prompt, or
orchestration.

constraints.statement: Qualification consumes Probabilistic Work Boundary, UP-020 and Reconstruction Litmus, with independent assessment and externally owned UP-007 trace/promotion rules. Declare constructor competence/capability/context/configuration and independently authorized evaluator basis/comparison predicate. Constructor uses only ordinary declared method/authority surfaces; material expected/reference outcomes, exemplars/incumbents, author memory and ad hoc rescue are withheld until freeze where independence would be compromised. After freeze compare to mandatory governing semantic basis, without self-adjusting comparison after seeing results or substituting constructor authority. Reference outcomes never author law; subjective similarity, byte/structural identity, unique derivation, determinism or incumbent equality are not generic semantic criteria. Out-of-envelope construction cannot indict generic sufficiency. Post-exposure revision is declared intervention, a qualified method constituent or new subject, never a retroactive pass. Undeclared supplemental inputs, compromised exposure, missing basis/evaluator authority, improper reference requirements or omitted required equivalence defeat the qualification claim. No actor type/count, round count, engine, prompt or orchestration is prescribed.
constraints.uncertainty: Probabilistic Work Boundary and UP-007 details are outside the supplied source.

conditions: Demonstrating operational capability.
exceptions: Constraints, governance and verification-infrastructure requirements may need different evidence in addition to or instead of end-to-end scenarios.

grounding.quote:
A failed scenario
supplies a discrepancy to [Universal Intake Triage](#universal-intake-triage);
the failure alone does not distinguish a realization defect, inadequate
governing meaning, inaccurate prediction or an inadequate scenario, oracle or
observation. The scenario must expose operational behavior rather than merely
compare the specification's words with other words.

constraints.statement: Requirements answer what must be true, Design how truth is realized, Scenarios whether the realized system can perform the claim. Requirement/design words alone do not demonstrate capability; adequate end-to-end scenarios expose actual operations, not word-to-word comparisons. Failure enters intake as discrepancy and alone diagnoses neither implementation, governing meaning, prediction, scenario, oracle nor observation. Scenarios primarily validate capability/operational meaning and do not replace requirement categories.

conditions: Every executable proof surface and every claimed assurance lane.
exceptions: Implementation-derived regression checks retain supported local scope without becoming upstream acceptance.

grounding.quote:
For ticketed work, the immediate proof authority is the admitted ticket and its
triage path. Tests derive from the ticket's lawful re-entry point and the
governing constitutional or realization-law surfaces it cites; they do not
derive expected results from current implementation behavior.

constraints.statement: Declare each executable proof surface's authority. SPEC_METHOD owns Product taxonomy; DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD keeps module unit-proof ownership despite shared context. Ticketed expectations derive from admitted ticket/triage, lawful re-entry and cited governing surfaces, not current implementation. Bind each lane's expectation to source/justified interpretation and execution to actual subject/checker/environment/observations; class labels prove neither fidelity nor independent failure causes. Shared derivations may serve declared families in existing carriers. Design/module sources include governing Design, module ownership, IACS/equivalent inventory, structural diagrams when present and local fail-closed law; they test realization of designed boundaries. Unit is this class; integration/negative/fail-closed may be when module-targeted. UAT sources are requirements, acceptance criteria, scenarios/use cases and Product release/qualification claims, testing composed Product satisfaction.
constraints.uncertainty: External module-proof and parallel-assurance contracts are not supplied.

conditions: Calling a lane UAT/acceptance or claiming live acceptance.
exceptions: An explicitly equivalent isolated composed-product proof lane may be called UAT.
Local filenames/runner labels may differ if every executable lane maps to this taxonomy before closure.

grounding.quote:
Where a product or release
claim depends on live probabilistic compute, semantic green, unit green, module
integration green, and harnessed sandbox green are necessary but not sufficient
for live acceptance.

constraints.statement: Only sandbox or explicit equivalent isolated composed-product lanes are UAT. Sandbox exercises deployed/installed/runnable Product through declared application/public/runtime/control surfaces, driven by requirement-sourced scenarios/acceptance. Source units/helpers/module integration alone cannot close user acceptance. Harnessed UAT exercises full composition/orchestration/control/projection/archive/scenario wiring using non-live deterministic/fake/recorded/injected results and supports reproducibility. Live UAT crosses the real configured external boundary and returns result/evaluation/provenance/projection evidence. Live-dependent Product/release claims require semantic, unit, module-integration and harnessed success but those are insufficient for live acceptance. Unit names authority scope; integration breadth; sandbox composed acceptance; harnessed/fake/recorded/deterministic non-live execution; live means actual external execution, not a status view named live.

conditions: Required closure lanes or proof needing external project fixtures.
exceptions: External evidence is permitted through a minimal in-source fixture, a manifest naming source/version/acquisition-or-binding rule, or classification as harnessed/live sandbox, reference comparison or optional local evidence rather than required semantic closure.

grounding.quote:
For the Product property the diagnostic is `indeterminate` when the fixture
absence leaves evidence insufficient, retaining independent counterevidence or
basis/scope diagnoses. A separately assessed `required fixture is available`
predicate may be `falsified` when absence is established. Preserve whether the
Product evaluation was undertaken; an unavailable fixture is not by itself a
Product counterexample.

constraints.statement: Required closure lanes are reproducible from declared source boundaries. Unit/semantic/module-design lanes cannot depend on undeclared local/sibling/home paths or mutable external fixtures. External evidence must use one stated lawful route. Missing fixtures fail with governed diagnostic naming fixture authority and lane, not simulated Product semantic failure. Insufficient Product evidence yields indeterminate while preserving independent counterevidence/basis/scope diagnoses; separately established fixture unavailability may falsify 'required fixture is available'. Record whether Product evaluation occurred; absence alone is no Product counterexample.

conditions: Every live requirement.

grounding.quote:
Every live requirement must have written testcase authority.

That authority may include scenario bundles, ordered testcase sequences, negative
or control cases, and other explicit evidence cases as appropriate to the kind of
truth being proved, but it must exist in written form and be traceable.

No live requirement is considered fully proved if it relies only on informal
operator confidence, ambient habit, or an unlabeled test corpus.

constraints.statement: Every live requirement has written traceable testcase authority, using scenario bundles, ordered sequences, negative/control cases or other explicit evidence suited to its truth kind. Informal confidence, habit or an unlabeled test corpus alone cannot constitute full proof.

conditions: A requirement claims meaningful system behavior.

grounding.quote:
Where a requirement claims meaningful system behavior, the proving surface should
be a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered set of testcases that exercises that
behavior through a coherent sequence rather than as disconnected fragments.

constraints.statement: Isolated assertions alone do not prove features. The proving surface should use a scenario bundle or equivalent coherent ordered testcase sequence showing feature/use-case boundary, proving sequence and expected significant-step outcomes. This is a recommendation of form, not an unconditional bundle mandate. Declared scenarios pressure intent/Design to name operational boundary, sequence, actors, controls and outcomes and are the preferred source of significant code/control paths that proof must exercise.

conditions: The system has an installable or runnable development form.

grounding.quote:
Direct source-level or unit-level checks may remain useful, but they do not
replace installed-dev proof of the system under test.

constraints.statement: The decisive proving lane runs an installed development version as an independent project or externalized target, not only an in-place source tree. It should prefer a fresh sandbox/equivalent isolation, installed/built development artifact and actual declared Product entry/control/runtime surfaces. These preferences retain recommendation force; source/unit checks remain useful but do not replace installed-dev proof.

conditions: Proof of claimed behavior.
exceptions: The listed path kinds are usual examples where relevant, not a universal demand for every branch.

grounding.quote:
If the significant paths are not declared, scenario coverage cannot be judged.
If they are declared but not exercised, the behavior is not fully proved.

constraints.statement: Declare and exercise significant claimed-behavior paths. Exhaustiveness means intentional proof of named meaningful paths, not every possible branch/file. Relevant usual paths include success, fail-closed/rejection, boundary/control, integration/dispatch/transport and recovery/retry/replay. Undeclared paths make scenario coverage unjudgeable; declared but unexercised paths leave behavior incompletely proved.

conditions: Every live requirement family.
exceptions: A path, filename or packaging rule belongs to requirements when itself constitutional truth.

grounding.quote: Requirements should also avoid freezing concrete realization choices prematurely. Unless a path, filename, or packaging rule is itself part of the constitutional truth, those choices belong to design rather than the requirement surface.

constraints.statement: Categorize every live requirement family by truth kind: Capability, Constraint/Guarantee, Governance or Verification. All remain constitutional; category is neither priority nor a user-facing claim. Requirements span full WHAT, Design structural HOW with ADRs as one durable form, and Scenarios operational capability meaning. Not every requirement should become a marketed feature. Requirements should avoid premature concrete choices; ordinary paths/filenames/packaging belong to Design unless constitutionally necessary.

conditions: Specification-driven sufficiency or reuse of an accepted reconstruction relation.
exceptions: Exact current accepted basis and sufficient evidence may be reused after applicability/invalidation checks.
A local claim determines its reconstruction span and need not recreate the whole Product or unchanged accepted views.

grounding.quote:
Reconstructability requires a correct reconstruction route, not its execution
at every use. It grants no restart authority and does not excuse stale success.
The claim determines the reconstruction span; a local selected function does
not require recreating the whole Product. New material counterexamples still
challenge the affected relation. Where `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` applies, it
owns design-view coverage, its material-change gate and unchanged-boundary
reuse; this litmus does not waive that gate or require recreating unchanged
accepted views.

constraints.statement: Specification-driven layers must be reconstructable in order by competent teams: Goals→Intent, Intent→Product, Product→Requirements, Requirements→Design, Requirements+Design→Realization. Failure to derive Intent indicates unclear/contradictory/nonconcrete Goals; Product failure vague/contradictory/nonconcrete Intent; Requirements failure underspecified/contradictory/nondecomposable Product; Design failure underspecified/contradictory/accidental-detail requirements; Realization failure incomplete/ambiguous/nonoperational Design for its binding. ADRs/Design supply governing realization decisions. Hiding major ambiguity defeats upstream sufficiency even if an artifact exists. Sufficiency allows different conformant designs and software/human/mixed realizations, not unique derivation. Reuse requires exact current applicability and no invalidation; reconstructability neither mandates repeated reconstruction nor authorizes restart/stale success. New counterexamples challenge affected relations. Applicable DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD gates and view-coverage/reuse ownership remain intact.
constraints.uncertainty: External module design-view and material-change gates are not supplied.

conditions: Selecting concrete realization mechanisms.
exceptions: Upstream constitutional constraints already governing technology, carrier, runtime, filenames or placement remain binding.

grounding.quote:
- requirements may say that authoritative bootstrap or control surfaces must be present, carry bare axioms, and route to the canonical method
- design decides whether those surfaces are entry documents, embedded blocks, standalone compiled artifacts, or another lawful topology

If filenames and placement are hardcoded in requirements without constitutional necessity, the requirement surface has absorbed design detail and made re-derivation harder.

Unconstrained stack/carrier/runtime selection belongs to Design, not a separate upstream authority. Requirements may demand authoritative bootstrap/control presence, bare axioms and canonical-method routing; Design chooses entry documents, embedded blocks, compiled artifacts or other lawful topology. Hardcoded filenames/placement without constitutional necessity improperly absorb Design detail and impede re-derivation.

grounding.quote:
The method does not prescribe an internal decomposition, search,
collaboration, tool, or synthesis procedure when variation in that procedure
cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety, or release
property. Increased agent capability may enlarge the bounded relation an agent
can resolve; it does not grant authority, weaken an invariant, or waive
acceptance.

allowed: Implementation-owned internal evaluation order and lawful fact reuse.
Design-supported direct, composite or nested forms and coherent composite bases.
No prescribed realization mechanism or participant count.
forbidden: Effects before validation of every material participant and join.
Admitting participant subsets or nested constituents as complete truth.
Using a partial or competing same-scope path to bypass owner derivation/validation.

grounding.quote:
Every participant and join is validated before any transition effect. Internal
evaluation order and lawful reuse are implementation-owned, but no participant
subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth. Admission is one semantic
commit of the complete transition, bound to its exact basis identity; failure
or interruption admits the complete transition or none, never a subset. No realization
mechanism or participant count is prescribed.
